steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Supreme in Filter environments. Click Supreme Court, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the court
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Look at the columns, the steps and the big doors. If you can, go inside and look at where the judges sit.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until the court building fits.

Click Record video. Say your 2 sentences. Click it again to stop.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Record a new video and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Start your video far away, then walk closer, so Opti sees how big the building is.

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, that shows the court while you say both sentences.

place.alt: A white building with columns and a small dark dome, with a tall building behind it
place.html: Florida's three parts: the Legislature makes laws, the governor leads, and the courts decide what the laws mean.

say: This is the Supreme Court, and I see ___.

studio.title: Florida Memory Match
studio.look: Twelve face-down cards. Six show a picture of a Florida symbol or place. Six show its name. A symbol is something simple that stands for something bigger.
studio.do: Tap two cards to flip them. If a picture and its name match, they stay up. If not, they flip back. Remember where they were!

labels.step: Flip two cards. Find a picture and its name.

game.miss: Not a match. Remember where they are, and try again.
game.done: All six pairs! Florida picked its symbols to honor true things about our land and history.

pairs.ok: Yes! The sabal palm lives through hurricanes, salt spray and hot sun.
Yes! The mockingbird copies other birds' songs and adds its own.
Yes! Every orange starts as a blossom.
Yes! The seal shows the sun, land, people and water.
